title: Nm-seq
protocol: Set up the RNA fragmentation reaction in a thin-walled PCR tube.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 95°C for 5 minutes in a pre-heated thermal cycler block with the heated lid closed.
Add 2 μl of stop solution immediately after incubation and mix well by vortexing.
Purify fragmented RNA using an RNA Clean & Concentration-5 kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Elute purified RNA in 15 μl molecular biology grade, RNase-free water.
Set up the 3’ end repair reaction in a thin-walled PCR tube.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Purify 3’ end-repaired fragmented RNA using RNA Clean & Concentration-5 kit.
Elute purified RNA in 15 μl of molecular biology grade, RNase-free water.
Set up the oxidation-elimination reaction in a dark tube.
Mix the reaction components well by vortexing and spinning down.
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 30 minutes with shaking.
Quench the reaction by adding 2 μl of ethylene glycol.
Mix well and spin down after quenching.
Dephosphorylate by adding 5 μl of CutSmart Buffer (10X).
Add 2 μl of rSAP enzyme (2 units) to the dephosphorylation mixture.
Add 1 μl of molecular biology grade, RNase-free water for a total reaction volume of 50 μl.
Mix well and spin down after adding reagents.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes with shaking.
Purify RNA using RNA Clean & Concentrator-5 kit.
Elute purified RNA in 32 μl of molecular biology grade, RNase-free water.
Repeat steps 7-12 seven more times.
Repeat steps 7-9 once without dephosphorylation (steps 10-11).
Purify RNA using RNA Clean & Concentration-5 kit after the final oxidation-elimination step.
Elute purified RNA in 32 μl of molecular biology grade, RNase-free water.
Set up the 5’ dephosphorylation reaction.
Mix well by gentle tapping.
Spin down the mixture.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Purify RNA using RNA Clean & Concentration-5 kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Elute in 8 μl molecular biology grade, RNase-free water.
Use purified RNA from step 18 to construct a small RNA library using NEBNext® Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina.
Perform 3’ adaptor ligation overnight at 16°C.
